abilities.d: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to attack, you can select one of the following for this unit’s attacks to have: - [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle]. - Or: [Sustained Hits 1: non-[Monster/Vehicle] - Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle] and [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]
In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. That unit has Scouts 6".
This model can be attached to the following units: TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD, TERMINATOR SQUAD

coreAb.d: This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.

Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

facAb.d: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one Combat Doctrine listed below. If you do, that Combat Doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command Phase Assault Doctrine When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. Devastator Doctrine This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] Tactical Doctrine When this unit is selected to make a Fall-back move, that Fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge. Unless otherwise stated. - You can only select each Combat Doctrine once per battle - Only one Combat Doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule make a Combat Doctrine active for a unit, any Combat Doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1 CP

abilities.d: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
While this model is within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit, this model has Lone Operative.

In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model: - That Vehicle model heals 3 wounds. - That Vehicle model’s attacks can ignore modifiers to the following until the start of your next Movement phase: - BS. - Hit rolls and wound rolls.
This model can be attached to the following units: AGGRESSOR SQUAD, ERADICATOR SQUAD WITH HEAVY BOLTERS, ERADICATOR SQUAD WITH MELTA RIFLES, HEAVY INTERCESSOR SQUAD
